KHBB.Settings.Anchor.Name: Boss bar anchor
KHBB.Settings.Anchor.Hint: Choose the screen edge from which the bars grow. At the top, new bars are added below; at the bottom, they are added above.
KHBB.Settings.Effects.Name: Boss bar effects
KHBB.Settings.Effects.Hint: Choose effects for this device. Subtle only animates the bar; Cinematic adds a gentle screen shake and particles around the visible token. Reduced-motion and photosensitive modes automatically disable motion effects.
KHBB.Controls.ThemeHint: Automatic chooses from boss data. A manual choice applies to this bar and is shared with all players.
